trigger.Name: NewGame
trigger.script:
trigger:Deactivate()

local diff = GetDifficultyLevel() if diff == 0 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1.5") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 2") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 1 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.000015") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") elseif diff == 2 then RuleConsole("/ai_clash_coeff 0.003") RuleConsole("/ai_player_weapons_damage_coeff 0.75") RuleConsole("/ai_enemies_ramming_damage_coeff 1") RuleConsole("/ai_min_hit_velocity 30") end
bb = SpawnMessageBox("777") AutoSave() g_Console:InputLine "/exit"
PassToMap("r1m1","FromR1M2")
